name: timeline-milestones
title: Timeline: Roadmap
description: A horizontal timeline of milestones that scrolls sideways on phones.

files.content:
// A horizontal roadmap: milestones left to right, scrolling sideways on narrow screens. import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge" import { Timeline, TimelineContent, TimelineDescription, TimelineIndicator, TimelineItem, TimelineSeparator, TimelineTime, TimelineTitle, } from "@/components/ui/timeline" const MILESTONES = [ { quarter: "Q1 2026", title: "Invoices", note: "Send, track and get paid by card.", status: "done" }, { quarter: "Q2 2026", title: "Reminders", note: "Automatic follow-ups in your tone.", status: "done" }, { quarter: "Q3 2026", title: "Recurring billing", note: "Retainers that bill themselves.", status: "done" }, { quarter: "Q4 2026", title: "Multi-currency", note: "Bill in 30 currencies.", status: "current" }, { quarter: "Q1 2027", title: "Accounting sync", note: "Two-way sync with your books.", status: "upcoming" }, ] as const export default function TimelineMilestones() { return (

Roadmap

Updated Nov 24
{MILESTONES.map((m, i) => ( {i + 1} {m.quarter} {m.title} {m.note} ))}
) }
